title: Crestline Credit Card Uplift on the Out-of-Area Replacement Cap
content:
Crestline Credit Card holders receive a higher cap on the reimbursement of an out-of-area tire replacement under Road Hazard Protection.

**Out-of-area card cap uplift.** A holder who has a Crestline Credit Card account in status active and no late fee posted on their Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole calendar months raises the out-of-area cap by 50 USD; a holder with an active Crestline card account and one or more such late fees in that period raises it by 25 USD; any other holder keeps the plan's out-of-area replacement cap.

| Active Crestline Credit Card account | Late fees, last 12 whole months | Out-of-area cap |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | the plan's out-of-area replacement cap plus 50.00 |
| yes | one or more | the plan's out-of-area replacement cap plus 25.00 |
| no | (not relevant) | the plan's out-of-area replacement cap |

*Hypothetical cases.* On a plan with a 175.00 cap: 225.00 for a cardholder with no late fee, 200.00 for one with a late fee in the period, 175.00 for a holder with no active card account.
